g.text: Power Outage!

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Conductors and Insulators - Storyboard
A sudden power failure has left the city in darkness.
Can you restore electricity by choosing the right materials?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Test the Materials
Different materials are available for repair.
Test each object and observe what happens in the circuit.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Observe the Results
If the bulb glows, the material is a conductor.
If the bulb does not glow, it is an insulator.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Choose Wisely
Select suitable materials to repair the damaged power line.
Safe choices keep electricity flowing safely.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Where Do We Use Them?
Conductors carry electricity in wires.
Insulators protect us from electric shock.
Both are essential in everyday life.
Examples:
Charging cables
House wiring
Electric appliances
Safety gloves

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Restore the City
Use your knowledge to complete the repair.
Bring electricity back to homes safely.
Mission Complete! You restored power safely.
